visualCharacteristics: A vertical list of expandable question/answer rows. Each row shows a question with a plus/expand indicator; clicking reveals the answer below. Uses native details/summary for accessibility.
contentPattern: One row per FAQ entry with two cells: the first holds the question text (becomes the clickable summary), the second holds the answer content (shown when expanded).
usage: Use for a Frequently Asked Questions list of expandable question/answer pairs.
